name: weekly-callin-post
description: Drafts your weekly #weekly_call_in project update ahead of the Tuesday 10am call-in. Pulls your active projects from Airtable, reconciles against recent Slack posts, gathers the week's progress from meetings/SharePoint/email/calendar, and writes a review-ready Slack draft. Requires Airtable, Slack, Otter, and M365 connectors (Granola optional).
